import { DemoPlayer } from './src/components/DemoPlayer.js'; const SHARE_STEP = 4; // Step index when to add second phone // Generate unique session ID for this landing page instance // This prevents ghost states when multiple tabs view the landing page const sessionId = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10); const demoDocId = `demo-maps-${sessionId}`; console.log('[Landing] Session ID:', sessionId, 'Doc ID:', demoDocId); // Store reference for cleanup let demoPlayer = null; demoPlayer = new DemoPlayer({ container: document.getElementById('maps-demo-container'), demoScript: 'maps', editorUrl: `/doc/${demoDocId}`, // Unique per session sessionId: sessionId, enableSync: true, // Enable Y.js sync from the start for addSecondPhone steps: [ { label: 'Writing', heading: 'Writing', text: 'Just type - like any other doc' }, { label: 'Location Tagging', heading: 'Location Tagging', text: 'Double-tap text to create geo-marks' }, { label: 'Fullscreen Map', heading: 'Fullscreen Map', text: 'Click any map to expand and explore' }, { label: 'Transport', heading: 'Transport', text: 'Add routes between locations' }, { label: 'Share', heading: 'Share', text: 'Invite friends to collaborate in real-time' }, { label: 'Video Call', heading: 'Video Call', text: 'Discuss your trip together' } ], autoStart: true, offlineMode: true // No server dependency - prevents failed network requests }); // Add second phone (Bob) when reaching the Share step demoPlayer.onStepChange = (step) => { console.log('[Landing] Step changed:', step); if (step === SHARE_STEP) { // Add Bob's phone after the overlay finishes setTimeout(() => { demoPlayer.addSecondPhone(); }, 2500); } }; // Cleanup on page unload to prevent ghost states window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { console.log('[Landing] Page unloading - destroying demo player'); if (demoPlayer) { demoPlayer.destroy(); demoPlayer = null; } });
